notes.title: Update v2.0

[PATCH] v 2.0
-Huge UI update
-Auto progress "disable" after time has been removed. (Where it turns the button black and you have to search for an urn) --- Your autoprogress will still turn off if defeated.

While I realize it's not "content" per se, I wanted to give the game some love and I'm only the artist not the programmer so this is what I could do for you guys ^_^. 

I was attempting to make it cleaner, easier to read, easier to use, and more straightforward with its text.

Hope you enjoy it none the less.

[PATCH] v 1.8 - 2/27/19
-We've updated the Game's UI
-You'll find your gods, consumables, and minibuffs all in collapsible windows on the left.
To collapse or uncollapse a window, simply click the arrow on the panel.
-NOTE: All collapsed windows still function, ie, consumables still run etc.
-Currencies have been consolidated and can be seen by simply hovering over the word -CURRENCIES- in the top right corner.
-Floating #s now stream from each side with a label. Loot #s can be found in bottom center.
-God Card indicators can now be seen by hovering over the word -GOD CARDS-.
-Most windows now have an icon that says INFO instead of the ?
-"X" to close windows is now in the bottom right hand corner of windows.
-DPS, Click DMG and your DoTs can be found by hovering over the center crossed swords.
-Notifications can be found in the top right corner.
-Version number is in the bottom left of the path area.
-The Store button can now be found in the top left of the screen.
-BATTLE BOARD: You'll find in general that the battle board is now easier to win. The rewards have been reduced slightly to match the change in difficulty.
-DAILY GOALS: Quite a few of the daily goals have been adjusted to make them take more similar amounts of time.
-GOD CARDS/SHOP: The God Cards are now locked again. You must own all Champions to unlock Gods, and own all Gods to unlock Old-Gods. Any cards already owned will still remain working.
-LEADERBOARDS: Have been reset as of 2/24 - It can take time for them to repopulate but we like for them to stay fresh.
-ANCIENT CHESTS: An indicator has been added to the Ancient Chests for when you have 200+ Keys. Keys are also now shown in the Ancient Chests window.
-Companion Minigame: Now no longer drops consumables from the 5+ matches.
-CLICKS: Heph's feeling a bit more stingy with handing out clicks every 10 seconds. He's been reduced.  If you find yourself running out of clicks, remember you can farm a lower path to gain more auto-clicks.
-CHAT: Has been removed from the game. Feel free to chat with others on the forums or join in the GAC discord!  (https://discord.gg/ghF9RZ8)

notes.title: [PATCH] v 1.3D - 10/28/18 Save/Server issues
notes.notes:
Version 1.3D is live. We've fixed the Server issue that was caused by the European time change. It's there and stable now! 

The servers are up and working again. Daily rewards/Vouchers/Saves/Chat/Leaderboards are all working again.

For those that were playing on 1.3C you'll want to transfer your save file over. You'll find direction on how to do that below.

For those that didn't play on 1.3C you can just load up your game normally.

Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you all for your patience!


[b]ONLY DO THIS IF YOU PLAYED ON VERSION 1.3C
[/b]
[i]This is a one-time thing to make sure you have access to your local save for those of you that were playing while the servers were down. It shouldn't need to happen again.[/i]
Make sure your game is closed:
Open your File Explorer and type %appdata% into the address bar. 
Go to Locallow from the base appdata folder. 
In Locallow is Mad Labyrinth Studios and in there are two folders: 

You'll want to go into "God Awefull Clicker" and rename your save file there to  GACsave2.es2 to keep it as a backup.
Then you'll want to COPY the GACSave.es2 FROM "GAC" into the "God Awefull Clicker" folder.
You should then be able to launch the game normally.

notes.title: [PATCH] v 1.0.9 - 10/6/18
notes.notes:
[PATCH] v 1.0.9 - 10/6/18 

-DAILY LOGINS now exist. These will reset each day. (You won't have to relog in each day to get the reward, it just resets at a certain time). Enjoy the rewards
-Vouchers: You now gain 1 extra weekly vouchers for each 3k paths you've reached.
-Voucher Wheel: -Consumables increased to 250 (was 100)
-650 Apples reduced to 200 Apples (You can now get some from daily rewards as well. But the amount on the wheel was feeling unfair to others).
-2% EXP from wheel increased to 15% (This is not back compatible).
-Hammers have been changed to Collect Storm. Collect storm gives 100 collectibles.
-COLLECTIONS: Collections can now be uniquely collected infinite times. This means for every 15/15 you complete you get the bonus reward. There is NO need to hold on to your collections until you finsh your current 15/15 as it knows how many you have completed and applies it to the next sets. 
-BLESSINGS: Two new blessings have been added at level 1. Hades' Touch, and Aether's Support (Dmg & Health respectively). I'd recommend putting points in them even if you're past them as the amount does add up.
-BLESSING: Ares' Wararmor (Hp/DMG) has been moved from Path 3500 to path 2750. Its cost has been reduced and its max level has been drastically increased.
-DIVINE BLESSINGS WINDOW - Reset cost for blessings has been reduced to 2 apples (down from 5).
-GODPOWER: Base drop CHANCE of godpower increased to 15% (up from 6%).
-BOSSES: Godpower dropped from divine sources has been increased significantly.
-RELICS: Relics drop chance increased.
-QUESTS: Quests are now capped at 150 (Down from 350).
-Urn and collectible no longer spawn on god portraits
-QUESTS: Completing a quest now grants a good chunk of EXP as well
-Finding an Artifact now also grants EXP for your gladiator.
